name: vetee-api
description: Work with the Vetee GraphQL API through authenticated MCP connections for master, beta and stage.

defaultPrompt: Use $vetee-api in master for read-only GraphQL queries. Mutations are strictly forbidden unless I explicitly request the concrete change.
Use $vetee-beta-api in beta for read-only GraphQL queries. Mutations are strictly forbidden unless I explicitly request the concrete change.
Use $vetee-stage-api in stage for read-only GraphQL queries. Mutations are strictly forbidden unless I explicitly request the concrete change.
